> [!readaloud] The gate
> A gate of black iron.

This applies to any Fell that looks closely.

> [!lorecheck] Vigilance: Seeing it
> Every Fell rolls.
>
> - **Fellmark.** *Read:* You see it all. *Then:* Their Vigilance increases by 1.
> - **Success.** *Read:* You see it.

> [!dialogue] Mara
> *If asked who she is:* "Mara. I keep the [[01 - The Gate|gate]]."

> [!dialogue] Mara
> *If asked why:* "Somebody has to."

> [!dialogue] A stranger
> "Move along."

## Going in

> [!quest] Open the gate
> Get through before dawn.

> [!choice] How to get in
> - **Climb.** Go to [[02 - The Fight|The Fight]].
